definitions.gloss: New Year, the beginning of the new year
definitions.explanation: A formal and slightly literary term for the New Year period. Used in greetings, advertisements, and announcements around the start of the year.

examples.japanese: {新春|しんしゅん}おめでとうございます。
{新春|しんしゅん}セールが{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: The New Year sale has started.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}{新春|しんしゅん}には{特別|とくべつ}な{番組|ばんぐみ}がテレビで{放送|ほうそう}される。
examples.english: Every year, special programs are broadcast on TV during the New Year period.

notes:
USAGE:
{新春|しんしゅん} is more formal and literary than {正月|しょうがつ} (New Year). It is commonly used in greetings, advertisements, media, and ceremonial contexts rather than in everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新春|しんしゅん}セール: New Year sale
- {新春|しんしゅん}{特別|とくべつ}{番組|ばんぐみ}: New Year special program
- {新春|しんしゅん}のお{慶|よろこ}びを{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます: formal New Year greeting
- {新春|しんしゅん}{初|はつ}{売|う}り: first sale of the new year

ETYMOLOGY:
The characters {新|しん} (new) + {春|しゅん} (spring) reflect the traditional East Asian calendar where the new year fell in early spring.
